_doc: NEMA-IQ variant of geometry.json: the phantom is a water body cylinder (R=10 cm, half-length 9 cm) — the attenuator. The activity map (background + six hot spheres) is defined inline in the run config's [[source.region]] entries (Option B), all sharing this phantom's water material (uniform attenuation). World and scanner are identical to geometry_sphere.json. Dimensions in cm.
